decisive_items: a 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex
on incision of the cyst wall purulent fluid was noted
response.rationale: A purulent cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex in a young woman with right lower-quadrant pain and inflammatory markers is most consistent with a tubo-ovarian abscess; the normal appendix excludes appendicitis.

rejected.why: Ovarian cyst alone does not account for the purulent fluid and infectious/inflammatory presentation.
Appendicitis was surgically excluded because the appendix appeared clinically normal.
Ovarian cyst infection captures the pus but is less specific than tubo-ovarian abscess for a mass involving the tubo-ovarian complex.
